newsitem.title: HONG KONG: ChMer Direct puts US$10mln in road project.
newsitem.headline: ChMer Direct puts US$10mln in road project.

text.p: China Merchants China Direct Investments Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to invest US$10 million for a 16.8 percent stake in the 114-km highway Zhangzhou section of China's National Highway No. 324.
China Direct said it was investing jointly with China Insurance Group Investment Co Ltd, with the two firms taking a total 25.2 percent of the project.
The section, which connects Fujian and Guangdong provinces, is currently operated by joint venture company Zhangzhou Tongda Road Development Co Ltd and comprises three toll stations.
Reconstruction works were completed at the end of 1995, the investment fund said.
Chinese partner in Zhangzhou Tongda is Zhangzhou Highway Traffic Industry General Co, a unit of Zhangzhou municipality, it added.

China Merchants China Direct Investments, which has total assets of US$100 million, said this was its second toll highway project following its US$5 million investment in the Luomei section of National Highway No. 324 west of Guangdong.
Its shares were untraded at HK$3.60 on Tuesday.
